domain: chat TODO/plan subsystem hardening after dynamic steps
summary: Audited the dynamic-step plan change from WAVE-060 and fixed three weak spots it introduced, two of them self-inflicted, plus the missing test coverage.

findings.finding: shouldDisplayPlan was dead code. It was added so a trivial turn renders no checklist, but nothing called it - the promised behaviour never happened in the UI.
findings.fix: ChatPanelView.queenActivityFeed now gates on it; logic moved to the tested PlanDisplayPolicy.

findings.finding: Plan length was unbounded once steps appended per tool call, so a long run could bury the active row and inflate the persisted record.
findings.fix: PlanOverflow folds the oldest COMPLETED steps into a counted 'Earlier steps' summary. Pending, running, cancelled and failed steps are never folded - they are still actionable.

findings.finding: Write amplification: every step transition wrote the plan to the SQLCipher-encrypted database. Steps changed about twice per turn before, once per tool call after.
findings.fix: PlanPersistPolicy coalesces intermediate writes on a 2s interval and always writes terminal states immediately. Measured: 20 rapid steps produce 2 writes instead of 20.

findings.finding: The stateful planner had no tests; WAVE-060 only covered the pure deriver.
findings.fix: tests/swift/todo_planner_state_test.swift, 17 checks over overflow, persistence and display gating.

competitor_research: LangChain agent streams: detail streams only when a UI asks for it - cheap summary and expensive detail are different channels.
Deep Agents subagent snapshots: a step should stay a cheap record; volume belongs behind a disclosure.
assistant-ui multi-agent: nested tool-call threads are the accepted answer to list length.
AgentScope PlanNotebook: revise_current_plan is first-class, so plans must tolerate mid-run edits rather than assuming append-only.

lessons.lesson: Adding an API and not wiring it is indistinguishable from not doing the work. shouldDisplayPlan shipped as dead code in the same session it was announced as a feature.
lessons.how_to_apply: After adding a public affordance, grep for call sites outside its own file before claiming the behaviour exists.

lessons.lesson: Making a list dynamic silently changes its cost profile. Per-tool-call appends turned a twice-per-turn encrypted write into a per-tool-call one.
lessons.how_to_apply: When a data structure goes from fixed to unbounded, re-check both its display bound and its persistence frequency in the same change.

lessons.lesson: Folding overflow must distinguish completed from actionable. Hiding a pending or failed step would misrepresent the plan's state.
lessons.how_to_apply: PlanStepState.isActionable encodes this; only non-actionable steps fold.

verification.build_sh: 0 app-source errors, trios_app built, chat e2e 0 failures
verification.dead_code_check: shouldDisplayPlan now has 1 call site outside its own file
verification.duplicate_policy_check: 0 inline duplicates of the persist/overflow logic remain in TODOPlanner

known_gaps: Nested sub-steps for delegated work are not implemented (P1).
Mid-run plan revision (reorder/rewrite pending steps) is not implemented (P1).
The chat scroll/footer glitch the user reported is not addressed in this wave.
